this IS the DESIGN.md label step (10.5px) expressed in rem; Material's root is 20px, so 0.525rem == 10.5px. Same for the paired 0.725rem == the 14.5px headline step. Both reproduce the .nx-brand-name/.nx-brand-hg lockup exactly.

The comm readout's inbound/outbound spine, not a card accent (ADR-66, imported kind-for-kind from 'Canvas Object System copy copy 2.dc.html'). The 3px edge on a clipped-corner tinted readout IS the direction channel; removing either edge destroys the distinction the object system encodes in geometry. Colour here encodes ownership, never status. Scoped to landing/styles.css and widened from the two per-declaration entries this supersedes because impeccable 4.x extracts no value for side-tab (hook-lib.mjs extractFindingIgnoreValue directValueRules), so a declaration-text entry can no longer match.

The owner's bar: the object system's COLOUR channel, naming the domain that ships an object (ADR-58 established it, ADR-66 imported it kind-for-kind, ADR-69 ported it to light). The radius IS the kind's silhouette and the bar is the top edge, so they are two channels rather than a clash; a full colour wash per kind is an explicitly rejected alternative, and confining colour to a 3px bar is why it survives both themes. Scoped to landing/styles.css and widened from the per-declaration entry it supersedes because impeccable 4.x extracts no value for this rule (hook-lib.mjs extractFindingIgnoreValue directValueRules), so a declaration-text entry can no longer match.
